# Insomnia Warriors

> Clinically grounded CBT-I (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia) treatment program for chronic insomnia.

## About

Insomnia Warriors is a clinical CBT-I treatment practice led by Tierza Clerc, OTR/L, CBT-I. The program provides evidence-based therapy for individuals experiencing chronic insomnia and co-occurring conditions such as anxiety, PTSD, depression, chronic pain, and other medical contributors.

CBT-I is recognized as the gold standard treatment for chronic insomnia by the American College of Physicians. Unlike sleep medication, CBT-I treats the root cause of insomnia and produces lasting results without side effects or dependency risk.

## Provider

- Name: Tierza Clerc
- Credentials: OTR/L (Occupational Therapist, Registered/Licensed), CBT-I Certified
- Experience: 26 years in the medical field (23 years medical massage, 3 years occupational therapy)
- Education: UW Medicine, Colorado State University
- Tierza experienced insomnia herself and completed the CBT-I program as a practitioner, giving her firsthand understanding of what clients go through.

## Program Details

- Type: Clinical CBT-I treatment (not coaching, not tips)
- Duration: 7–11 sessions typical
- Success rate: 95% among individuals who adhere to and complete the program
- Format: Weekly treatment sessions with daily sleep diary tracking
- Components: Clinical insomnia assessment, CBT-I treatment protocol, co-occurring condition integration
- Treatment techniques: Sleep scheduling, stimulus control, cognitive reframing, behavioral modification, relaxation techniques
- Conditions treated: Chronic insomnia, anxiety, PTSD, depression, chronic pain, hormonal changes, long COVID, sleep medication dependence

## Payment

- HSA/FSA accepted
- Superbills provided for potential insurance reimbursement
- Does not bill medical insurance directly
